plan.scope: Exploratory distinct-day local chronological contrast prediction. Five shared stations, two changed; different excluded target and reference allowlist. Not isolated day causality, cross-day coefficient transfer, absolute future RF, new confirmation or covariance qualification.
plan.stopping_rule: One fixed hour and full declared cohort; retain failures and unsupported predictions, no station or time replacements.

comparison_plan.fixed_inputs: All day-reference RF, station positions, weather, antenna calibration and baseline admitted reference paths; no refiltering by final-product elevation.
comparison_plan.evaluation: Same four models and chronological split. Compare zero and shared-satellite RMS, per-station gains and centered residual differences. Transfer rapid-trained shared offsets to final test rows as a labelled diagnostic, without refitting to test outcomes.
comparison_plan.stopping_rule: Same five named files; reuse retained v1 orbit/clock bytes with new receipts identifying local reuse, acquire remaining bias/attitude/ERP once. Retain failures, no substitute sources or scientific cohorts.
comparison_plan.scope: Same-provider rapid/final paired-product sensitivity, not independent truth or causal identification of physical errors. No target fit, target-state parsing, covariance qualification or production change.
comparison_plan.supersedes: v1 retained: native clock 3.04 rejected before calibration; same named files, new native-format adapter, no clock-version substitution

prediction_quantity: station/epoch clock-free residual contrasts; receiver clocks recalibrated at test epochs

comparison.quantity: Centered final-minus-rapid residual contrast; paired-product sensitivity, not error against truth
